summary: A two clinic Sydney orthodontic practice appears to lose calls to phone links that look wrong and a messy page title.

findings.problem: The tap to call links appear to use +610 and then the number, with an extra 0 after the country code.
findings.cost: A mobile visitor who taps to call may hear an error instead of your reception.
findings.fix: Correct +61 2 format in every call link.

findings.problem: The numbers appear on the page as +61 (02) 9451-3477, which mixes two formats.
findings.cost: A mixed format looks careless and can fail when dialed from abroad.
findings.fix: One clean format for both clinics.

findings.problem: The page title appears to end with a stray percent sign after the practice name.
findings.cost: Search results and browser tabs show the error to every new patient.
findings.fix: A clean title with the practice name and suburb.
